colophon.moonHeading: The moon is real. The sea is imagined.
colophon.astronomyParagraph: Astronomy Engine calculates the current Sun–Moon elongation, illuminated fraction, and topocentric moon coordinates. Waxing and waning are derived from the full 0–360° phase angle. The reference location is {referenceName}: {referenceLatitude}, {referenceLongitude}, elevation {referenceElevation} m.
colophon.moonArtParagraph: The ASCII disc is a procedural sphere with illustrative crater texture. It represents the real lunar phase, not a photographic lunar map. Its placement is composed for the page, rather than projected from the reference sky. Its phase orientation is fixed north-up; local sky rotation and libration are not rendered. The reference altitude and azimuth are available in the homepage observation notes.
colophon.motionParagraph: Lunar phase follows real-world time and is recalculated every minute while the page is visible. The slow sea-level envelope starts from the calculated Sun and Moon declinations, hour angles, and distances at {referenceName}, using a quadrupolar equilibrium potential. Its rotation is accelerated 720 times so a tidal cycle unfolds in about a minute. Six interacting wave scales, perspective, and slowly distorted flow shape the surface. Faceted glints follow the moon’s bright side and illumination; a new moon does not cast a full-moon reflection.
colophon.tideDisclaimer: This is an artistic visualization. It is not calibrated to a coastline, has no physical water-level units, and must not be used for navigation or tide predictions. Real tides require local bathymetry, coastline geometry, and measured harmonic constituents.
colophon.calendarParagraph: Calendar dates use China / Malaysia time (UTC+8), independent of your device’s timezone. The open-source lunar-javascript library converts those civil dates to the Chinese lunisolar calendar. A small festival registry recognizes Lunar New Year and Mid-Autumn Festival, excluding leap months.
colophon.accessibilityParagraph: The renderer targets 30 frames per second, caps pixel density, lowers the character count on small screens, and adapts if drawing is too costly. It pauses in hidden tabs and when the scene leaves the viewport. Reduced-motion preferences produce a still scene. Without JavaScript or Canvas, a pre-rendered ASCII snapshot remains visible; its date reflects the last site build.
colophon.technologyParagraph: This is a static Astro website hosted on GitHub Pages. Fonts are bundled locally: Cormorant Garamond and DM Sans (SIL Open Font License). There are no required paid APIs, cookies, analytics, or tracking scripts. Public GitHub metadata, when configured, is fetched only during builds and can fail without breaking the site.
colophon.cvParagraph: Placeholder entries are labeled and are excluded from the generated academic CV. The PDF uses PDFKit, an open-source generator, and shares its academic data with the website.
